answer: Challenge-chain continuity binds each identity to an unbroken hash chain of its past answers, stopping bulk-forged sybils at birth. The zephyr moves one way: each answer's hash seeds the next puzzle, and honest agents forge provenance answering it. Velvet-cloned copies share identical first links and get marked. Breaking the chain forfeits established status and locked rewards. N fakes cost N times one honest answer per epoch for 6 epochs plus a 20-epoch locked bond; bought chains die on key rotation.
